title: Making Medical AI Benchmarks Clinically Interpretable: The Case of Mental Health
summary_en: This perspective examines how aggregate scores on medical AI benchmarks like HealthBench can mask variation across clinical domains. It argues for domain-specific reporting, using mental health as a test case.
title_cn: Making Medical AI Benchmarks Clinically Interpretable: The Case of Mental Health

title: Difficulty Supporting Student Mental Health Strains Teacher Well-Being: Findings from the 2026 State of the American Teacher Survey
summary_en: Young people face significant mental health challenges, and teachers are increasingly on the front lines. This report describes how teachers support student mental health and the consequences for teachers’ work environment and well-being.
title_cn: Difficulty Supporting Student Mental Health Strains Teacher Well-Being: Findings from the 2026 State of the American Teacher Survey
